 Introductie 
Looking for a stable, well-paid production job where you work with your hands? 
We are looking for production workers (grinders) for the MGG metal factory in Tegelen. You will be grinding and finishing aluminum products. 
This is a physically active job in a 3-shift system, including night shifts. Perfect for people who enjoy practical work and are not afraid to work hard. 
 Wie zoeken we? 
This job is suitable for you if you: - Live near Tegelen and have your own accommodation and transport - Have experience working in a 3-shift system (or at least night shifts) - Speak English, German, or Dutch 
 Wat bieden wij je? 
What you get: - €20.18 gross per hour including allowances (see below how it is calculated) - Full-time job of 37,5 hours per week in 3 shifts - Travel allowance - Long-term, stable work - Chance of a permanent contract in the future - Opportunity to develop your technical skills 
How is the salary calculated? 
The basic hourly wage is €16.06. 
You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. 
On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. 
What you will be doing: - Grinding and finishing aluminum products - Working with tools and machines - Loading products into machines and robots - Checking product quality - Solving minor technical issues 
This is hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift.
